en.greeting: Hi! Today you'll learn to shift register: the same message written for a ministry, a client and a friend. We'll see what makes each register, how to choose one for the reader and the app, and the mixes to avoid.

steps.title: Three registers on one line
steps.text: At B2 you learnt formal words and formal letters. Now the C1 skill: moving between registers.
steps.body:
**Register** (tingkat formalitas) is a line, not two boxes:
- **Formal**: reports, letters to officials, academic writing. Full forms, one-word verbs (*postpone, investigate*), the passive, no chat words.
- **Neutral**: most work emails, LinkedIn. Clear and polite: *Could you …?, I'm afraid …*; some contractions (*I'm, we'll*) are fine. *Hi* + name.
- **Informal**: friends, chat apps. Contractions, phrasal verbs, dropped words (*Sounds good. Got it.*), *Hey*, emoji only with friends.

pairs.en: I am writing to inform you that …
pairs.id: Saya menulis untuk memberi tahu bahwa … (formal)

steps.title: One message, three registers
steps.text: Here's the same news (a meeting is postponed) for three readers, then a request in two registers.
steps.body: Notice what changes: the verb (*postpone → push back*), the person (the passive in formal, *we* and *I* in the others), contractions and length. *I'm afraid* is the neutral way to give bad news politely.

examples.en: I regret to inform you that the meeting has been postponed until further notice.
examples.id: Dengan menyesal kami sampaikan bahwa rapat ditunda sampai pemberitahuan lebih lanjut.

examples.en: I'm afraid we need to postpone the meeting. I'll send a new date soon.
examples.id: Mohon maaf, kami perlu menunda rapatnya. Saya akan segera mengirim tanggal baru.

examples.en: Hey, we'll have to push the meeting back, new date soon!
examples.id: Hai, rapatnya harus kita undur, tanggal barunya segera ya!

examples.en: I would be grateful if you could send the signed contract at your earliest convenience.
examples.id: Kami akan sangat berterima kasih jika Bapak/Ibu dapat mengirimkan kontrak yang sudah ditandatangani secepatnya.

examples.en: Could you send me the signed contract when you get a chance?
examples.id: Bisa kirimkan kontrak yang sudah ditandatangani kalau sempat?

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Rina is forwarding bad news from a formal letter to a colleague.

options: I'm afraid we can't extend the deadline.
Sorry mate, no way we can push the deadline!
We hereby inform you that the deadline is not extendable.
question.prompt: Which is the NEUTRAL version, for an email to a colleague, of this formal sentence? 'I regret to inform you that the deadline cannot be extended.'
question.explanation: **I'm afraid** + contractions (*can't*) = neutral: polite and clear, right for a colleague. *Sorry mate, no way* is informal, for a friend. *We hereby inform you* is stiff: *hereby* sounds like a legal document.

steps.title: Audience, channel, purpose
steps.text: How do you choose? Ask three questions before you write.
steps.body:
**Audience**: how well do you know them, how senior are they, what's the culture? **Channel**: formal letter or official email → formal; work email, LinkedIn → neutral; Slack, Teams, WhatsApp → neutral or informal, depending on the person. **Purpose**: bad news, complaints, money → more careful; quick logistics → shorter.

The **same person** can get different registers on different channels. Not sure? Go one step more formal, then **follow their lead**.

steps.title: One director, three channels
steps.text: Bu Ani is the Finance Director. Rina writes to her in three places, then messages her team.
steps.body: Report: formal and impersonal. Email: neutral (*Dear Bu Ani*: Pak / Bu + name is the local custom with Indonesian colleagues). Team WhatsApp: short but still respectful. Only the last one, to teammates she knows well, is really informal.

examples.en: The revised budget was approved by the board on 12 May.
examples.id: Anggaran revisi telah disetujui oleh dewan direksi pada 12 Mei.

examples.en: Dear Bu Ani, I've attached the revised budget. Please let me know if you have any questions.
examples.id: Yth. Bu Ani, saya lampirkan anggaran revisinya. Silakan kabari saya kalau ada pertanyaan.

examples.en: Noted, Bu Ani. I'll update the file today. Thank you!
examples.id: Baik, Bu Ani. Saya perbarui filenya hari ini. Terima kasih!

examples.en: Running ten minutes late, start without me!
examples.id: Telat sepuluh menit nih, mulai aja duluan!

steps.title: Pick the opening
steps.text: Rina has found a job ad on LinkedIn.

options: Hey! Saw ur post 😊 wanna chat about the job?
Dear Sir/Madam, I hereby express my interest in the vacancy as mentioned above.
Hi Ms Ong, I saw your post about the Data Analyst role and would love to hear more about it.
question.prompt: Rina wants to message Ms Ong, a recruiter she has never met, on LinkedIn about a Data Analyst role. Which opening fits best?
question.explanation: A stranger on LinkedIn → **neutral**: *Hi* + Ms + surname, a clear reason, polite. The first is chat (*ur, wanna*, emoji) for a friend. The second is stiff (*hereby*, *as mentioned above*) and uses *Dear Sir/Madam* although Rina knows her name.

steps.title: Don't mix registers
steps.text: The commonest C1 error isn't grammar: it's mixing registers in one message.
steps.body:
`Hey Mr Tan, wanna catch up about the contract?` mixes chat (*Hey, wanna*) with a formal name. Pick one point:
- formal: *Dear Mr Tan, would you be available to discuss the contract?*
- neutral: *Hi David, could we have a quick chat about the contract?*

Indonesian habits: bahasa baku word for word (`We hereby inform you`) is too stiff; WhatsApp style to a client (`Ok sir noted ya 🙏`) is too casual. Names: Mr / Ms + **surname**, never Mr + first name.

pairs.en: I am writing to inform you that …
pairs.id: Dengan ini kami beritahukan … (bukan 'We hereby inform …')
Bersama ini kami lampirkan … (bukan 'Herewith we attach …')
Atas perhatiannya kami ucapkan terima kasih.
sudah akrab: nama depan saja, tanpa Mr

steps.title: Spot the mix
steps.text: Budi is checking three messages before he sends them.

options: Dear Ms Wong, I am writing to request a copy of the March invoice. Kind regards, Budi
Dear Ms Wong, pls send the March invoice asap, thx! 😊
Hi Dimas, can you send me the March invoice when you get a chance? Thanks!
question.explanation: *Dear Ms Wong* is formal, but *pls, asap, thx* and the emoji are chat. The first message is formal all the way through; the third is informal all the way through (fine for a colleague like Dimas).

steps.title: Build the formal version
steps.text: Sari has to announce a delay on the company website.

question.solution: The product launch has been postponed until further notice.
question.prompt: Arrange the words to make the formal version of this chat message: 'Heads-up: we've pushed the product launch back, no new date yet.'
question.explanation: Formal = the **passive** (no *we*), the one-word verb **postponed** instead of *pushed back*, and the fixed phrase **until further notice** (= no new date yet).

steps.title: Formal partners
steps.text: Flip each card: the informal phrase on the front, the formal partner on the back.

flashcards.back: I'm afraid … / I regret to inform you that …
as soon as possible / at your earliest convenience

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here's the whole line on one page, to check before you press Send.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · Register shifting
artifact.intro: Find the reader and the channel, pick one column, and keep the whole message in it.
rows: I am writing to inform you that …
I wanted to let you know that …
I regret to inform you that …
I would be grateful if you could …
Please inform me of any changes.
Please let me know if anything changes.
Let me know if anything changes!
carry on / cut down on / sort out
tips: Formal: letters to officials, reports. Neutral: most work emails, LinkedIn. Informal: friends and close colleagues on chat apps.
Not sure? Go one step more formal, then follow their lead (if they sign 'Best, David', write 'Hi David').
Don't mix: check the greeting, the verbs and the sign-off belong to the same column. Mr / Ms + surname, never Mr + first name.

steps.title: Watch and practise more
steps.text: Two video lessons on formal, neutral and informal English (Oxford Online English and a BBC live class), and a short BBC programme about formality at work.

id.greeting: Hai! Hari ini kamu belajar menggeser register: pesan yang sama ditulis untuk kementerian, klien, dan teman. Kita lihat ciri setiap register, cara memilihnya sesuai pembaca dan aplikasinya, dan campuran yang harus dihindari.

steps.title: Tiga register dalam satu garis
steps.text: Di B2 kamu sudah belajar kata dan surat formal. Sekarang keterampilan C1: berpindah antar-register.
steps.body:
**Register** (tingkat formalitas) itu sebuah garis, bukan dua kotak:
- **Formal**: laporan, surat ke instansi, tulisan akademik. Bentuk lengkap, kata kerja satu kata (*postpone, investigate*), kalimat pasif, tanpa kata gaya chat.
- **Netral**: kebanyakan email kerja, LinkedIn. Jelas dan sopan: *Could you …?, I'm afraid …*; boleh sedikit singkatan (*I'm, we'll*). *Hi* + nama.
- **Informal**: teman, aplikasi chat. Singkatan, phrasal verb, kata dihilangkan (*Sounds good. Got it.*), *Hey*, emoji hanya dengan teman.

pairs.en: I am writing to inform you that …
pairs.id: Saya menulis untuk memberi tahu bahwa … (formal)

steps.title: Satu pesan, tiga register
steps.text: Ini kabar yang sama (rapat ditunda) untuk tiga pembaca, lalu sebuah permintaan dalam dua register.
steps.body: Perhatikan yang berubah: kata kerjanya (*postpone → push back*), pelakunya (pasif di formal, *we* dan *I* di yang lain), singkatan, dan panjangnya. *I'm afraid* adalah cara netral menyampaikan kabar buruk dengan sopan.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Rina meneruskan kabar buruk dari sebuah surat formal kepada rekannya.

options: I'm afraid we can't extend the deadline.
Sorry mate, no way we can push the deadline!
We hereby inform you that the deadline is not extendable.
question.prompt: Mana versi NETRAL, untuk email ke rekan kerja, dari kalimat formal ini? 'I regret to inform you that the deadline cannot be extended.'
question.explanation: **I'm afraid** + singkatan (*can't*) = netral: sopan dan jelas, cocok untuk rekan kerja. *Sorry mate, no way* itu informal, untuk teman. *We hereby inform you* itu kaku: *hereby* terdengar seperti dokumen hukum.

steps.title: Audiens, media, tujuan
steps.text: Bagaimana memilihnya? Ajukan tiga pertanyaan sebelum menulis.
steps.body:
**Audiens**: seberapa kenal kamu, seberapa senior mereka, bagaimana budayanya? **Media**: surat formal atau email resmi → formal; email kerja, LinkedIn → netral; Slack, Teams, WhatsApp → netral atau informal, tergantung orangnya. **Tujuan**: kabar buruk, keluhan, uang → lebih hati-hati; urusan teknis singkat → lebih pendek.

Orang yang **sama** bisa mendapat register berbeda di media berbeda. Ragu? Naikkan satu tingkat lebih formal, lalu **ikuti gaya mereka**.

steps.title: Satu direktur, tiga media
steps.text: Bu Ani adalah Direktur Keuangan. Rina menulis kepadanya di tiga tempat, lalu mengirim pesan ke timnya.
steps.body: Laporan: formal dan impersonal. Email: netral (*Dear Bu Ani*: Pak / Bu + nama adalah kebiasaan setempat dengan rekan orang Indonesia). WhatsApp tim: singkat tapi tetap hormat. Hanya yang terakhir, ke rekan tim yang sudah akrab, yang benar-benar informal.

examples.en: The revised budget was approved by the board on 12 May.
examples.id: Anggaran revisi telah disetujui oleh dewan direksi pada 12 Mei.

examples.en: Dear Bu Ani, I've attached the revised budget. Please let me know if you have any questions.
examples.id: Yth. Bu Ani, saya lampirkan anggaran revisinya. Silakan kabari saya kalau ada pertanyaan.

examples.en: Noted, Bu Ani. I'll update the file today. Thank you!
examples.id: Baik, Bu Ani. Saya perbarui filenya hari ini. Terima kasih!

steps.title: Pilih pembukanya
steps.text: Rina menemukan lowongan kerja di LinkedIn.

options: Hey! Saw ur post 😊 wanna chat about the job?
Dear Sir/Madam, I hereby express my interest in the vacancy as mentioned above.
Hi Ms Ong, I saw your post about the Data Analyst role and would love to hear more about it.
question.prompt: Rina ingin mengirim pesan LinkedIn kepada Ms Ong, perekrut yang belum pernah ia temui, tentang posisi Data Analyst. Pembuka mana yang paling cocok?
question.explanation: Orang yang belum dikenal di LinkedIn → **netral**: *Hi* + Ms + nama keluarga, alasan yang jelas, sopan. Pilihan pertama gaya chat (*ur, wanna*, emoji), untuk teman. Pilihan kedua kaku (*hereby*, *as mentioned above*) dan memakai *Dear Sir/Madam* padahal Rina tahu namanya.

steps.title: Jangan campur register
steps.text: Kesalahan paling umum di C1 bukan tata bahasa: tapi mencampur register dalam satu pesan.
steps.body:
`Hey Mr Tan, wanna catch up about the contract?` mencampur gaya chat (*Hey, wanna*) dengan nama formal. Pilih satu titik:
- formal: *Dear Mr Tan, would you be available to discuss the contract?*
- netral: *Hi David, could we have a quick chat about the contract?*

Kebiasaan kita: bahasa baku diterjemahkan kata per kata (`We hereby inform you`) terlalu kaku; gaya WhatsApp ke klien (`Ok sir noted ya 🙏`) terlalu santai. Nama: Mr / Ms + **nama keluarga**, jangan Mr + nama depan.

pairs.en: I am writing to inform you that …
pairs.id: Dengan ini kami beritahukan … (bukan 'We hereby inform …')
Bersama ini kami lampirkan … (bukan 'Herewith we attach …')
Atas perhatiannya kami ucapkan terima kasih.
sudah akrab: nama depan saja, tanpa Mr

steps.title: Temukan campurannya
steps.text: Budi memeriksa tiga pesan sebelum mengirimnya.

options: Dear Ms Wong, I am writing to request a copy of the March invoice. Kind regards, Budi
Dear Ms Wong, pls send the March invoice asap, thx! 😊
Hi Dimas, can you send me the March invoice when you get a chance? Thanks!
question.explanation: *Dear Ms Wong* itu formal, tapi *pls, asap, thx* dan emojinya gaya chat. Pesan pertama formal dari awal sampai akhir; pesan ketiga informal dari awal sampai akhir (tidak masalah untuk rekan seperti Dimas).

steps.title: Susun versi formalnya
steps.text: Sari harus mengumumkan penundaan di situs web perusahaan.

question.solution: The product launch has been postponed until further notice.
question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya menjadi versi formal dari pesan chat ini: 'Heads-up: we've pushed the product launch back, no new date yet.'
question.explanation: Formal = kalimat **pasif** (tanpa *we*), kata kerja satu kata **postponed** sebagai ganti *pushed back*, dan frasa tetap **until further notice** (= belum ada tanggal baru).

steps.title: Pasangan formal
steps.text: Balik setiap kartu: frasa informal di depan, pasangan formalnya di belakang.

flashcards.back: I'm afraid … / I regret to inform you that …
as soon as possible / at your earliest convenience

steps.title: Ringkasan
steps.text: Ini seluruh garisnya dalam satu halaman, untuk dicek sebelum kamu menekan Kirim.

artifact.intro: Tentukan pembaca dan medianya, pilih satu kolom, dan pertahankan seluruh pesan di kolom itu.

I regret to inform you that …
I would be grateful if you could …
Please inform me of any changes.
Please let me know if anything changes.

carry on / cut down on / sort out
tips: Formal: surat ke instansi, laporan. Netral: kebanyakan email kerja, LinkedIn. Informal: teman dan rekan akrab di aplikasi chat.
Ragu? Naikkan satu tingkat lebih formal, lalu ikuti gaya mereka (kalau mereka menutup dengan 'Best, David', tulis 'Hi David').
Jangan campur: pastikan salam pembuka, kata kerja, dan salam penutup ada di kolom yang sama. Mr / Ms + nama keluarga, jangan Mr + nama depan.
